# Adding `logs` bucket + IRSA + Flux kustomization

**Note on a spec inconsistency:** the task says "ACK S3 CRDs" but the group `s3.aws.upbound.io` is Crossplane's. Since the stack is ACK, I use the ACK schema (`s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1`, kind `Bucket`). If your cluster actually runs Crossplane, swap the group/kind — the overlay structure is identical.

## 1. Base: `infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-placeholder   # patched per-env
  versioning:
    status: Enabled
  publicAccessBlock:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  tagging:
    - key: env
      value: placeholder        # patched per-env
    - key: managed-by
      value: flux/ack
```

## 2. Base: `infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - ../iam/logs-irsa  # IAM role (base)
```

## 3. Base IRSA role: `infra/iam/logs-irsa/role.yaml`

Policy is scoped strictly to the logs bucket per environment (patched in overlays). Trust policy assumes the EKS OIDC provider.

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{
        "Effect": "Allow",
        "Principal": {"Federated": "OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN"},
        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
        "Condition": {
          "StringEquals": {
            "OIDC_PROVIDER_SUB": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer"
          }
        }
      }]
    }
  policies:
    - policyName: myapp-logs-rw
      policyDocument: |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Action": [
                "s3:PutObject", "s3:GetObject", "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
                "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
              ],
              "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME/*"
            },
            {
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
              "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME"
            }
          ]
        }
```

No wildcards — least privilege satisfied. OIDC provider ARN/URL are environment-specific and patched (or SOPS-encrypted if your repo treats them as sensitive).

`infra/iam/logs-irsa/kustomization.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
```

## 4. Overlays

`overlays/dev/logs/kustomization.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/tagging/0/value
        value: dev
  - target:
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/assumeRolePolicyDocument
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [{
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_ID"},
              "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
              "Condition": {"StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer"
              }}
            }]
          }
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/policies/0/policyDocument
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {"Effect": "Allow",
               "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject","s3:AbortMultipartUpload","s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"],
               "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"},
              {"Effect": "Allow",
               "Action": ["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],
               "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev"}
            ]
          }
```

`overlays/prod/logs/kustomization.yaml`: identical pattern with `myapp-logs-prod`, prod OIDC provider (different account/cluster ID), and `tag: prod`. (Duplicate as shown; only bucket name/OIDC values differ.)

If OIDC provider identifiers are considered sensitive in your repo, put them in a SOPS-encrypted secret and reference via a Flux `SecretProvider`/kustomize secret generator — nothing sensitive is committed plaintext here either way.

## 5. Flux kustomizations — `flux/logs-kustomization.yaml`

Add per-environment Kustomizations pointing at the existing Git source (`flux-system`), path-scoped so the logs bucket reconciles independently:

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
      namespace: flux-system
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/prod/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
      namespace: flux-system
```

## Checklist vs. requirements

| Requirement | How |
|---|---|
| `myapp-logs-{env}` | overlay patches `spec.name` |
| Versioning | `spec.versioning.status: Enabled` |
| AES256 SSE | `serverSideEncryptionConfiguration` rule |
| No public access | full `publicAccessBlock` (all four flags true) |
| IRSA read/write | ACK Role + inline policy scoped to bucket only, no wildcards |
| Separate Flux reconciliation | dedicated `Kustomization` per env, path-scoped, existing source |
| Env isolation | dev/prod overlays patch independently; prod changes can't touch dev state |

Note the ACK `Bucket` CRD doesn't inline `publicAccessBlock`/`serverSideEncryptionConfiguration` in all versions — if you're on an older ACK release, split them into separate `BucketPolicy`-adjacent child CRs (`PublicAccessBlock` is not split out; SSE config is subresource `bucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` in some versions). Verify against your installed CRD schema with `kubectl explain bucket.spec`.
